DnaJ
is
a
highly
polymorphic
gene ,
at
both
the
nucleotide
and
amino
acid
level .

The
amount
of
polymorphism
found
in
DnaJ
is
similar
to
the
amount
of
polymorphism

found
in
the
allorecognition
genes ,
fuhc
and
fester ,

have
been
shown
to
be
highly

( De
Tomaso
et

2005 ;
Nyholm
et
al . ,
2006 ) .
On

DnaJ

a

mean
pairwise
difference
of
33.35
±
4.77 .

45

37

23

and
34
